summary: TOYO Co., Ltd, a Cayman-incorporated, Tokyo-based solar cell and module manufacturer listed on Nasdaq (TOYO) and OTC (TOYWF), furnished a Form 6-K containing an investor presentation for an October 6, 2026 analyst day tied to the ribbon-cutting of its Humble, Texas module facility. The deck cites H1 revenue of $261.0M, 2.6 GW of cell deliveries, 32.5% gross margin, and $123.4M in cash plus restricted cash. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed; the filing is an ordinary operational update, not a special situation. Watch execution on U.S. capacity ramp and any future FEOC-related guidance.
